messages.subject: Shiny app working locally but not deployed on shinyapps.io
parts:
Question title says it all: My shiny app is working locally just fine. But when I deploy it to shinyapps.io, it immediately greys out with a "Disconnected from Server" popup. There's nothing in the log and none of the tricks I've found online have worked (re-installing and/or updating packages, using a smaller data file, etc.).

https://jesstme.shinyapps.io/shinynames/

The log is completely empty and the "Deploy" log in RStudio indicates successful deployment--see text in blue below. 

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 193997...DONE
Deploying bundle: 994423 for application: 193997 ...
Waiting for task: 489405538
  building: Building image: 992534
  building: Fetching packages
  building: Installing packages
  building: Installing files
  building: Pushing image: 992534
  deploying: Starting instances
  rollforward: Activating new instances
  terminating: Stopping old instances
Application successfully deployed to https://jesstme.shinyapps.io/shinynames/
Deployment completed: https://jesstme.shinyapps.io/shinynames/

Help?!

(I'm new to this google groups, please let me know if you'd like me to include my code or other relevant info!)
